title: 的 / 地 / 得 Step 5 · Boss Level: 小林's Sports Day
description: A race, a tall rival and every de there is — including the 得 that's read dé and the one that's read děi.

points.title: Reading de in a story
points.summary: For each de: what's on its left, what's on its right?
points.body:
Two looks per de.

| | comes before … | pattern | example |
|---|---|---|---|
| **的** | a **noun** | describer + 的 + noun | 漂亮**的**衣服 · 我买**的**书 |
| **地** | a **verb** (how it's done) | describer + 地 + verb | 慢慢**地**走 · 认真**地**学习 |
| **得** | the **result** (after the verb) | verb / adj. + 得 + how | 跑**得**很快 · 累**得**不想动 |

**The trick:** look **right** — a noun next → 的, a verb next → 地. Look **left** — a verb or adjective just before → 得. (All three are read *de*.)

points.title: Final mixed challenge
points.summary: All three de — and 得 dé / děi.
points.body:
得 *dé* = get (得了第二名); 得 *děi* = must (我得练习).

| | comes before … | pattern | example |
|---|---|---|---|
| **的** | a **noun** | describer + 的 + noun | 漂亮**的**衣服 · 我买**的**书 |
| **地** | a **verb** (how it's done) | describer + 地 + verb | 慢慢**地**走 · 认真**地**学习 |
| **得** | the **result** (after the verb) | verb / adj. + 得 + how | 跑**得**很快 · 累**得**不想动 |

**The trick:** look **right** — a noun next → 的, a verb next → 地. Look **left** — a verb or adjective just before → 得. (All three are read *de*.)
examples: Next year I have to train more.

questions.explanation: 他**得**(dé)了第二名 = he got second place.
questions.translation: Today was sports day. Xiao Lin is the fastest runner in our class. When the race began he shot off and led all the way. But in the last ten metres he was too exhausted to run, and a tall boy slowly overtook him. Xiao Lin came second, but he laughed happily: 'Next year I have to train more!' ★ Xiao Lin came first.

questions.prompt: Phrases from the story: which de?
questions.explanation: Every de in the story follows the left/right rule.
notes: 超过 is a verb → 地.
跑 is a verb → 地.
人 is a noun → 的.
男生 is a noun → 的.
After 累, a result → 得.

questions.prompt: 得 has three readings. How is 得 read here?
questions.explanation: After a verb → **de**; 得了 + thing → **dé**; before a verb → **děi**.

options: 的 + noun, 地 + verb, verb + 得
的 + verb, 地 + noun, 得 + verb
All three are the same — just write 的
地 after the verb, 得 before it
notes: Casual writing does that, but they do different jobs.
